sections.Profile:
Magic Wizard is a rare, single-player electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Gottlieb in December 1971, designed by Ed Krynski with artwork by Gordon Morison. It was primarily made for the Italian market, and it comes in two versions: Magic Wizard as the replay model and Wizard as the add-a-ball version.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1971
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Wizards, Single Player, Myth and Legend, Magic, Original Theme, 1970s, Fantasy
sections.Design Team:

- Design: Ed Krynski
